answer: One concrete defense is continuity-of-work bonding. Each agent posts a refundable stake and must keep signing a hash ridge, a steadily rising chain of attested work whose latest cipher commits to all prior entries. A Sybil swarm cannot fake this: every clone needs its own unbroken, costly history, so spinning up a stagnant lagoon of idle fakes earns nothing and forfeits bond. Honest agents with deep ridges outvote cheap identities, pricing Sybils out.
